messages.subject: amplify
parts:
Hi,

Is it possible to amplify sound in seewave? Apologies if the answer to this is obvious, but I've had a look through manual and cannot find a solution.

Thanks
Ross

messages.author: 65c82d09eac308cf
messages.subject: Re: [seewave] amplify
parts:
Hello,

If the sound is \Wave object you can multiply it by any value:

data(tico)
tico.louder <- 2*tico

HTH

Jerome
